SASBDB entry SASDGF3  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDGF3/)

Publication: Long non-coding subgenomic flavivirus RNAs have extended 3D structures and are flexible in solution.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.15252/embr.201847016

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder; fetch it from the DOI above (open access).
The fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDGF3/ cites the paper and its Appendix.

2026-11-13 (papers are the source of truth): the paper's Data availability makes SASDGF3 the
ZIKV-xrRNA1 (not xrRNA2); buffer (Appendix Table S2), 298 K and 0.8857 A (Table S6) agree with
SASBDB. Flagged caveat, entry kept: construct length 72 nt (paper) vs 68 nt (SASBDB record) vs
74 residues (model).

Files: SASDGF3_fit1_model1.pdb is the deposited ModeRNA model of xrRNA1 (74 residues), used
unmodified. 5TPY.pdb is the RCSB crystal structure of the xrRNA1 template (71 nt), kept for
reference only; it is not fitted. SASDGF3_fit1.fit is the deposited CRYSOL fit (chi2 0.754).
